jobs.title: (Senior) Cloud & AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Technical Consulting & Enablement: Provide professional services, including business technology consultation, cloud solution training, and technical enablement to support Tencent Cloud’s international business growth.
Solution Design & Migration: Collaborate with international architects and partners to design architecture on the Tencent Cloud platform. Guide customers and partners through system migration to the cloud, offering expertise in application and data migration, and supporting the development of applications and services on our platform.
Pre-sales & Project Coordination: Coordinate cross-functional resources from product, service, and operations teams to provide robust pre-sales technical support for key partner projects and strategic opportunities.
Ecosystem & Knowledge Development: Participate in building and structuring Tencent Cloud’s global technology partner ecosystem. Contribute by summarizing and documenting technical solutions and industry-specific use cases.

Who We Look For
Education & Core Experience: A Bachelor’s degree or higher, with over 5 years of hands-on experience in public or private cloud environments, and a solid understanding of technologies and solutions from major cloud providers.
Technical Breadth: Professional experience in at least two of the following domains: Software Development (proficient in Java, Python, or similar), System Operations & Maintenance, System Integration, Solution Design, Technical Consulting, Enterprise IT Systems & Architecture Management, Big Data, or AI.
Communication & Engagement: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and build trust with customer stakeholders at all levels—from business leaders and technical decision-makers to front-line engineers.
Mindset & Approach: A strong customer-centric mindset, a rigorous and detail-oriented work ethic, and a deep sense of responsibility. You are a proven self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and a proactive attitude.
Language Skills: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in a major European language (e.g., Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese) and/or Mandarin Chinese is a significant plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Netherlands-Amsterdam | UK-London

jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing Manager, Gaming
jobs.description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.
We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
1. Responsible for business development for IEGG game products across Türkiye and Eastern Europe, identifying and building long-term relationships with key strategic partners.
2. Establish, expand, and maintain external partnership networks, while closely tracking partners’ strategic priorities and business plans to identify collaboration opportunities and provide actionable partnership recommendations.
3. Develop a deep understanding of game publishing and live operations rhythms, including major version updates, summer campaigns, anniversaries, and other key milestones.
4. Independently lead external partnership projects, including proposal development, business negotiation, contract execution, localization planning, and on-the-ground implementation.

Who We Look For
1. Fluent in English, with the ability to use English as a working language. Any EEU Language efficiency is a strong plus. (i.e. Polish)
2. 5+ years of business development experience in the internet or gaming industry; candidates with strong, monetizable local partner resources are preferred.
3. Passionate about the gaming industry and an experienced gamer, with the ability to accurately assess the fit between partnership opportunities and the tone, audience, and positioning of each game.
4. Strong cross-cultural communication skills, business negotiation capability, and crisis management ability.
5. Highly self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Türkiye-Istanbul

jobs.title: AI安全蓝军高级工程师
jobs.description:
1.负责公司核心业务与 AI 场景的安全评估和对抗演练，从安全研究视角发现真实风险，通过渗透测试、漏洞挖掘、风险验证和场景化演练等方式，持续发现安全防御体系中的薄弱环节，并推动风险闭环；
2.研究 AI 时代的新型安全风险与前沿技术，重点关注大模型、AI Agent、MCP、Agent Skills、AI 基础设施及供应链等方向，研究提示注入、Agent 异常行为、工具误用、敏感信息风险、权限越界、供应链风险等新型安全问题；
3.探索 AI Agent 驱动的自动化安全能力，利用 LLM、Reasoning Model、Agent、Tool Use、Multi-Agent 等技术，研发自动化漏洞发现、渗透测试、风险路径规划、漏洞验证等能力，持续提升安全工作的自动化和规模化水平；
4.建设面向真实业务的 AI 安全评测体系，沉淀漏洞案例、安全测试方法、Benchmark、评测数据和安全知识库，将安全专家经验转化为可复用、可持续迭代的 Agent 能力；
5.跟踪国内外前沿安全与 AI 技术发展，快速分析新漏洞、新型风险及 AI 安全问题，通过技术研究、原型验证和工程化落地，将前沿技术转化为实际安全能力；
6.与业务、安全研发、算法及平台团队紧密协作，对发现的问题进行风险分析和技术路径还原，帮助业务准确理解问题的实际影响，并推动高风险问题完成修复和体系化治理。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1、AI Copilot 系统研发：负责本地化 AI Copilot 系统的架构设计与核心代码编写，实现 AI 辅助翻译、术语推荐、译后编辑（PE）等功能。
2、向量检索与 RAG 落地：负责向量数据库（Vector DB）的选型、搭建与优化；利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，将现有的翻译记忆库（TM）和术语库（TB）转化为向量，实现高召回、高精准的上下文检索。

5、本地化 TMS 系统开发与运维：负责本地化 TMS 系统的新特性开发与已有功能的维护、性能优化，实现本地化流程自动化和全球应用。

1、本科及以上学历，计算机、语言类、本地化或相关专业，有3年以上实际开发经验。扎实的编程能力，熟练掌握 Python / Go / Node.js 中的至少一种开发语言，具备良好的编码规范。
2、大模型开发经验：熟悉 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等主流 LLM 开发框架，有实际的大模型 API（如 Google Vertex AI, OpenAI）对接与工程化落地经验。

4、游戏本地化认知：了解游戏端内外内容的本地化流程和实践，有游戏本地化版本成功交付经验者优先；熟悉翻译、审校、 配音或LQA流程，对游戏本地化有独到的见解，善于利用工具和 AI 能力持续优化本地化效率和质量。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

jobs.title: Agent Security Expert
jobs.description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are building the next-generation Agent security product to protect enterprise AI workloads at scale. As our Agent Security Expert, you will define the technical architecture for real-time agent defense and lead the product's security roadmap in a fast-emerging global market. You will work at the intersection of application security, AI safety, and systems engineering, shaping how enterprises safely deploy autonomous agents across their digital infrastructure.Own the end-to-end technical architecture of our Agent security product, making principled trade-offs across detection coverage, latency, and operational overhead.
Design and implement runtime guardrails — including prompt injection defense, unauthorized tool-call interception, behavioral drift detection, and real-time credential leak prevention.
Architect MCP and tool-chain supply-chain security capabilities against tool poisoning, cross-origin privilege escalation, and transitive trust abuse.
Build an automated agent red-teaming pipeline to continuously discover vulnerabilities, generate adversarial test cases, and harden defenses before production deployment.
Partner with product, engineering, and threat intelligence teams to translate emerging attack patterns into shipped security features, and mentor junior engineers on security-first design.

Who We Look For
8+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, systems engineering, or a closely related field, with a track record of shipping production security components.
Deep expertise in at least two of: application security, cloud-native security, identity and access management (IAM), or offensive/defensive security operations.
Proficient in at least two of Go, Python, Rust, or C++, with experience building high-concurrency security services or detection pipelines.
Strong working knowledge of the LLM/Agent stack — RAG architectures, function calling, MCP protocol, and mainstream agent frameworks — and the unique attack surfaces they introduce.
Experience researching or shipping enterprise security products (EDR, CNAPP, AI-SPM, or equivalent); familiarity with sandboxing, eBPF, or container/virtualization isolation is a strong plus.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

腾讯游戏商务部的主旨是建立腾讯与全球优质厂商的桥梁，服务与全球100+投资伙伴和重要厂商。持续扩大腾讯在全球互联网生态和游戏行业的影响力，利用敏锐的嗅觉捕捉高潜力商业合作机会，并帮助投资伙伴持续的成长。深耕亚太、欧美和新兴市场，与日本、韩国、美国、英国、法国、芬兰、德国等成熟市场和东南亚、中东、土耳其等新区域的伙伴建立了深度的战略合作关系，实现商业上的共赢。
商务部期待全球的优秀人才一同加入，通过全球的优质人才网络巩固和扩大腾讯与全球合作伙伴的合作关系，并为市场孵化更多优质的游戏产品。

岗位职责
1.负责部门 Agent 产品研发，与业务、Agent 产品及运营团队紧密合作，将业务需求转化为可实现、可验证、可量化的技术方案，承担架构设计、前后端开发、测试、部署及持续迭代的完整闭环。2.负责 Agent 核心能力建设，包括企业知识库、RAG、记忆系统、工具调用、业务 Agent、MCP，以及 Multi-Agent 与人机协作流程的设计和实施。
3.负责 Agent 与腾讯内部基础设施及产品的集成，包括模型与 Agent 平台、权限身份体系、知识库及数据平台，并通过 API、SDK、MCP等方式建设稳定、可复用的连接能力。
4.建设部门 Agent Benchmark、评测与可观测体系，通过自动化评测、回归测试、Tracing、日志监控和反馈闭环，持续优化任务成功率、生成质量、稳定性、响应速度及成本。
5.建设生产级工程与安全保障体系，包括 CI/CD、自动化测试、灰度发布、故障恢复、权限控制、操作审计和数据隔离，保障 Agent 产品安全稳定运行。

岗位要求
1.本科及以上学历，5 年以上软件研发经验，具备复杂系统或产品从0到1交付经验；能力和作品突出者可适当放宽。2.熟练掌握 JavaScript/TypeScript，熟悉 React 或 Vue 中至少一种主流前端框架。熟练使用 Python、Go、Java或基于 Node.js 的服务端开发技术，熟悉 API、数据库、缓存及异步任务，具备独立全栈交付能力。3.理解 Agent Loop、Memory、Tool Calling、RAG、MCP、Planning及 Multi-Agent 等技术，并具备实际 Agent 项目开发或生产落地经验。4.具备良好的工程、产品和跨团队协作能力，重视代码质量、测试、可观测性、安全性及上线结果，能够熟练使用 AI Coding 工具提升研发效率。加分项
生产级 Agent、开发者工具或企业知识助手的落地经验。
企业知识图谱、agent/LLM评测或反馈数据闭环经验。
企业数据库系统建设，多来源数据库治理经验。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

jobs.title: Associate, Global AI Policy
jobs.description:
About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails
A.	About Tencent
       Tencent is a leading global technology and entertainment company focused on connecting people and developing innovative products and services. Founded in 1998 and publicly traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 2004, Tencent’s communication and social services, entertainment (video games, music, sports, and film/TV), fintech, cloud, and enterprise solutions are used by hundreds of millions of people around the world.
       Tencent has been recognized as one of the “World’s Best Employers” (Forbes), including as one of the “Best Workplaces for New Graduates” (2026); one of the “World’s Most Admired Companies” (Fortune); and one of the “World’s Best Companies” (Time). In addition to its headquarters in Shenzhen, Tencent maintains offices across Asia, Europe, North America, and Latin America, including Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Palo Alto, Los Angeles, New York, and Washington, D.C. To learn more about the company, visit www.Tencent.com (About Us). 
       B.	About the Role
       Tencent is seeking a highly motivated Associate, Global AI Policy to join its Global Public Affairs team in Palo Alto. This early-career position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, public policy, technology, and international affairs.
       The Associate will support Tencent's global AI policy efforts by researching emerging policy developments, monitoring legislative and regulatory activity, analyzing technology trends, and helping develop insights for Tencent businesses. The role will work closely with colleagues across public affairs, legal, compliance, and AI and Cloud product teams, while also engaging with external stakeholders including policymakers, think tanks, industry associations, academic institutions, and civil society organizations.
       While the position will be based in Palo Alto, the successful candidate will contribute to Tencent's assessment and understanding of broader AI trends globally, including the US but also Europe, Asia-Pacific, etc.Policy Research & Analysis
Monitor and analyze developments related to artificial intelligence, including machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI, semiconductors, and other emerging technologies.
Track and assess industry initiatives and policy developments in the United States and other key international markets.
Prepare concise policy briefings, research memoranda, presentations, and executive summaries for internal stakeholders.
Support analysis of AI policy trends and their potential implications for Tencent's business and technology strategy.
Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and policy developments relevant to Tencent's AI and cloud businesses.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with internal teams across public affairs, legal, compliance, product, engineering, and research functions.
Assist with the development of policy positions, consultation responses, and external-facing materials.
Support preparation for meetings, conferences, speaking engagements, and policy discussions.
Stakeholder Engagement
Assist in managing relationships with think tanks, academic institutions, trade associations, and policy organizations.
Support Tencent's participation in AI policy forums, conferences, workshops, and industry events.
Help coordinate internal and external meetings and maintain stakeholder engagement databases and tracking tools.

Who We Look For
We are looking for an intellectually curious individual who enjoys learning about complex issues and translating them into clear insights for business and policy teams. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, a disciplined researcher, and someone who is genuinely excited by the policy questions surrounding artificial intelligence and emerging technologies. Successful candidates may come from leading universities, graduate programs, consulting firms, think tanks, policy research organizations, or technology companies. Most importantly, they should possess strong analytical instincts, sound judgment, and a desire to help shape the future of AI policy in a rapidly changing global environment.
Specific qualifications include:
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Relevant fields include Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Economics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, Law, or related disciplines.
Strong interest in artificial intelligence, technology policy, innovation, and emerging technologies.
Exceptional research, writing, and analytical skills are required.
Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and multi-cultural environment.
Familiarity with AI governance, technology regulation, or digital/cloud policy preferred.
Mandarin with international teams preferred but not required 
Experience conducting quantitative or qualitative policy research.
Location State(s)
US-California-Palo Alto
The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $82,700.00 to $200,600.00 per year. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: HR Compliance Associate
jobs.description:
Business Unit
The S3 HR and Management Line follows a "User-Focused and Employee-Oriented" philosophy and employs a three-pillar HR organization model. By offering "productized services and marketized management," the S3 HR and Management Line provides comprehensive support for developing Tencent's organization, talent, and culture, enabling employees to grow with the company.

What the Role Entails
About Tencent
Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.
We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward. Combining the results-oriented nature of a start-up with the resources of a profitable and leading Internet company, Tencent offers a unique opportunity for aspiring individuals to thrive.
About the Role
As an HR Compliance Associate supporting our Asia Pacific business, you will help ensure that Tencent's people practices meet local employment legislation, statutory obligations and internal governance standards, with a primary focus on Singapore. Working closely with HR colleagues, business leaders and regional stakeholders, you will support employment compliance, HR governance and employee relations casework across a multi-country region, building deep and practical expertise in employment regulation in one of Asia Pacific's most closely regulated markets.
Responsibilities
Support compliance with employment legislation and statutory requirements, with a primary focus on Singapore, including the Employment Act, the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act and Ministry of Manpower regulations; partner with country HR colleagues to track regulatory developments and help translate changes into practical process updates.
Support employee relations casework under the guidance of senior HR and Legal colleagues, including case intake and triage, evidence and document collation, interview scheduling and note-taking, timeline construction, case file maintenance and follow-up tracking, exercising strict confidentiality, neutrality and consistency of process throughout.
Serve as a point of support for employee relations and employment compliance enquiries escalated from employees, managers and HR Business Partners, facilitating resolution and partnering with the business, HR, Legal and other stakeholders to deliver fair and consistent outcomes.
Ensure employment documentation and HR records are audit standard, covering employment contracts, Key Employment Terms, policy acknowledgements, disciplinary and grievance records, personnel files and retention schedules, ensuring records are complete, accurate and defensible under review.
Support internal and external audits, labour compliance reviews and HR governance activities by assembling evidence, reconciling records against source systems, tracking remediation actions through to closure and documenting outcomes.
Support the periodic review, risk assessment and rollout of HR policies across the region, working with legal advisors to ensure local policies remain aligned to both Tencent global standards and country-specific legal requirements.
Build and maintain the employee relations and policy knowledge repository, and support the development of manager training materials on fair employment practices, grievance handling and proper documentation.
Identify control gaps and propose practical improvements, including better use of HR case management and workflow systems to reduce manual handling and strengthen compliance tracking.

Who We Look For
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Law, Psychology or a related discipline.
Approximately 1–3 years of experience in Human Resources, People Operations, employee relations or employment compliance. Outstanding fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are also encouraged to apply.
Familiarity with Singapore employment legislation and fair employment practices is a strong advantage. A genuine interest in employment regulation and the willingness to build real depth in this area is essential.
High emotional intelligence and interpersonal maturity, with the ability to handle sensitive situations with professionalism, confidentiality and empathy, and to build trust with employees and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.
Analytical and meticulous, able to conduct precise fact-gathering, maintain accurate records and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a strong sense of accountability, integrity and discretion, and the discipline to meet deadlines and produce work that withstands audit scrutiny.
Comfortable working with HR systems and data, able to build and maintain trackers and case records, reconcile information across sources and use technology to improve operational efficiency.
An initiative-taking communicator who keeps stakeholders well informed, asks questions, flags risks early and takes ownership beyond assigned responsibilities in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.

2.引擎动画管线开发：在 Unreal Engine（或 Unity）中搭建与调试动画蓝图（AnimBP）、状态机、混合空间（Blend Space）、Pose Driver、Animation Notify 等；处理 Root Motion、IK Retargeter、Control Rig、动画重定向（Retargeting）等技术环节，确保动画资产在引擎内正确运行；开发基于物理的动画系统，如布娃娃（Ragdoll）混合、布料/毛发物理解算、刚体/软体交互；探索程序化动画（Procedural Animation）与运动匹配（Motion Matching / Pose Search）等前沿技术方案；
3.动捕数据处理：负责光学/惯性动捕原始数据的清理、补点、去噪、滑步修正与重定向，输出高质量可用动作资产；与动作导演、动画师协作，保障动作表演质量与项目美术风格统一；
4.管线规范与工具开发：制定并持续优化动画相关的制作规范、资产接入标准、调试流程和质量校验标准；使用Python/MEL/HLSL 等脚本语言，为动画团队开发自动化工具，提升生产与迭代效率；编写清晰的技术文档，推动绑定与动画管线的迭代升级；
5.跨部门协作：与动画师、绑定师、角色美术、引擎程序保持密切沟通，处理美术资产从 DCC（Maya/3ds Max/Blender）到引擎落地的全流程问题；监督动画资产整合到游戏引擎的全过程，及时反馈并解决技术限制。

jobs.title: Lead Game Development Expert, AI-Asset & Animation Production
jobs.description:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a senior game development expert with deep AAA production experience to strengthen co-development and technical partnership between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios.
The successful candidate will bring a strong technical art and animation background, with a particular focus on asset production and animation workflows. Instead of covering the full breadth of art disciplines, this role concentrates on AI-enabled asset creation, asset performance optimisation, asset visual fidelity and on the animation side skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.Participate in co-development projects between Tencent and its overseas investment and partner studios, providing senior expertise in AI-enabled asset production, asset performance optimisation, asset visual quality, skeleton design, rigging and physics-based animation.
Make AI-driven asset and animation improvement a central pillar of technical collaboration. Identify concrete opportunities across the full asset lifecycle (modelling, texturing, materials, LODs, performance profiling) and animation disciplines (skeleton generation, skinning, control rigs, cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics and ragdoll setups).
Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept projects that integrate AI tools with existing asset authoring tools, animation rigging environments, physics engines, and Unreal Engine or equivalent game engines.
Evaluate the suitability, feasibility and expected value of AI solutions for asset and animation challenges. Define measurable metrics covering asset creation time, memory/performance budgets, visual fidelity, rigging speed, animation quality, physics stability and overall pipeline scalability.
Work closely with Art Directors, Technical Artists, Animators, Riggers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, Engineers, Producers and AI specialists to translate creative and production requirements into practical, measurable solutions focused on assets and animation.
Drive the transition of successful AI experiments into daily production workflows. Collect user feedback, refine asset and animation pipelines, and document repeatable implementation approaches for asset generation, optimisation, rigging automation and physics setup.
Establish human-review and quality-control mechanisms for AI-assisted asset and animation workflows, ensuring visual consistency, animation fidelity, physical plausibility, performance targets and intellectual property/data security are respected.
Lead technical investigations and solution designs for complex asset production challenges (e.g., automated LOD generation, material and texture optimisation, shader performance) and animation challenges (e.g., auto-rigging, physics-aware motion, real-time cloth simulation).
Bridge overseas studio requirements with Tencent’s internal AI capabilities, asset platforms, animation technology stacks and subject-matter experts.
Document reusable AI use cases, asset pipeline standards, rigging and physics best practices, performance guidelines and evaluation methods. Share knowledge through workshops, technical reviews and project retrospectives.
Monitor trends in generative AI, neural rendering, procedural content generation, machine learning for deformation and physics, digital humans and real-time graphics, assessing their practical value for AAA asset and animation production.

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Graphics, Digital Media, Game Development, Art and Design, Animation, Software Engineering or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
At least 8 years of professional experience in technical art, animation technology or a closely related discipline, with significant exposure to AAA asset and animation pipelines.
Experience operating as a Senior Technical Artist, Lead Technical Artist, Technical Art Director, Animation Pipeline Lead, Rigging Lead or equivalent senior role with a clear focus on assets and/or animation.
Proven development experience on a recognised AAA game project, including at least one shipped AAA title where you were directly responsible for asset optimisation, rigging, or physics-animation workflows.
Strong understanding of the complete AAA asset and animation lifecycle, from initial modelling and rigging, through version control and validation, to engine integration, performance profiling and runtime optimisation.
Strong interest in generative AI, machine learning and intelligent automation, especially as applied to asset generation, asset optimisation, auto-rigging, motion synthesis, deformation prediction and physics simulation.
Ability to identify high-value AI opportunities rooted in real asset and animation production challenges and progress them through proof-of-concept, workflow design, tool integration and production adoption.
Strong experience with Unreal Engine or another major game engine, including real-time rendering, asset management, animation blueprints, physics assets and cross-platform performance constraints.
Proficiency in Blender or Maya; working knowledge of Houdini is a plus.
Experience with tools development or workflow automation using Python, C++, Blueprint or equivalent, particularly for asset processing, rigging automation or physics pipeline tools.
Strong problem-solving, solution design and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance asset quality, animation expressiveness, engineering feasibility and production efficiency.
Excellent English communication skills, able to lead technical discussions, conduct solution reviews, prepare documentation and collaborate effectively in an international environment.
Willingness to work across regions and time zones and to travel to partner studios in Europe or other locations when required.

Deep expertise in several of the following areas:
​​(1) AAA asset production pipelines (characters, environments, props) with a strong emphasis on performance optimisation, memory budgets, LOD strategies and visual consistency.
(2) Asset visual quality and efficiency: material authoring, texture optimisation, shading models, draw call management and cross-platform asset validation.
(3) Skeleton design and character/creature rigging: hierarchical structures, joint placement, modular rig systems, and auto-rigging methods.
(4) Skinning and deformation: linear blend skinning, dual quaternion skinning, corrective blendshapes, muscle systems and deformation quality control.
(5) Physics-based animation: cloth, hair, rigid-body dynamics, ragdoll setups, secondary motion, and real-time physics constraints in engine.

Job Description
Research and optimize content generation models (text, image, audio, 3D models, etc.) to address challenges such as generation quality, diversity, controllability, and efficiency.

PhD (preferably fulltime) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or related fields.

jobs.title: Senior Anti-Fraud Strategy Engineer
jobs.description:
Business Unit
Corporate Development Group (CDG) as the platform for the company's new business incubation and new business exploration, CDG is responsible for promoting development and innovation for important areas such as financial technology and advertising, as well as marketing services, including payment and financial applications. As a professional support platform, CDG also supports the company and various business groups in strategic planning, investments and mergers, investor relations and corporate global communications, marketing and public relations, and more.

What the Role Entails
Key Responsibilities
Strategy Development: Develop and iterate end-to-end anti-fraud strategies for the overseas AdN, covering pre-bid, in-flight, and post-event phases. Target various fraud schemes (e.g., IVT, click farms) across multiple ad formats.
Advanced Analytics & AI: Leverage distributed data platforms and large-scale models (LLMs) to conduct in-depth mining of ad events. Integrate AI technologies to achieve precise risk identification, extract high-value features, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
Performance Optimization: Define and track core anti-fraud KPIs. Optimize strategy precision through A/B testing to balance fraud prevention with legitimate traffic growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Business teams to deploy strategies into real-time risk engines, ensuring low latency and alignment with business goals.
Industry Monitoring: Monitor global ad fraud trends and industry standards; proactively adjust strategies to counter emerging threats in key overseas markets.
Ecosystem Health: Manage fraud-related disputes with publishers and advertisers. Collaborate to promote anti-fraud best practices and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations.

Who We Look For
Technical Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
3-5+ years of hands-on experience in anti-fraud strategy, traffic quality, or risk management within the mobile ad tech industry.
Strong data processing and analysis capabilities with familiarity in distributed data platforms. Proficiency in SQL and Python is required; experience with LLM applications is a strong advantage.
In-depth understanding of the mobile ad ecosystem, attribution logic, monetization models, and industry standards (e.g., IAB).
Deep understanding of various ad fraud tactics and verifiable experience in designing anti-fraud strategies and AI-driven risk identification.
Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to collaborate effectively with global teams and stakeholders.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills; able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience in overseas ad business or AdN operations at top-tier tech companies.
Deep understanding of AI/ML technologies for fraud detection, with practical experience in innovative AI applications.
Familiarity with real-time stream processing frameworks (e.g., Flink, Kafka), rule engines, or big data platforms.
Experience in game ad monetization or app ecosystems; TAG certification or compliance experience is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Business System Analyst (Workday Financials)
jobs.description:
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. Recognized as an approved employer by esteemed organizations like ACCA, HKICPA, CIMA, CPA Australia, and CA, and certified accredited trainer with the Singapore Accountancy Commission, we provide comprehensive resources and guidance to ensure our employees remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving finance landscape. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced hire, we empower you to acquire and maintain professional qualifications, enhancing your credibility and competence in the finance domain while keeping you competitive in the ever-changing industry.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Finance is seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Analyst to join our Finance IT Management Department. This role serves as a strategic partner between Finance and Technology, responsible for the design, configuration, optimization, and support of enterprise financial and planning systems within a modern cloud environment.
The Senior Business Systems Analyst leads requirements discovery, translates business objectives into scalable system solutions, and drives continuous improvement across finance processes, integrations, data models, and reporting. The role ensures system stability, compliance, and long-term scalability while supporting enhancements, testing, and production operations in a fast-paced, global environment.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities:
Act as a subject matter expert across enterprise finance systems, supporting functional areas such as Financial Management, Procurement, Banking & Settlement, Projects, Expenses, and Supplier Management
Partner with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, develop conceptual and detailed solution designs, and configure systems to meet evolving business needs
Lead system configuration, testing, and deployment activities, supporting end-to-end delivery from design through go-live
Prepare detailed effort estimates, implementation plans, and testing strategies based on functional and technical requirements
Analyze, design, document, and validate system configurations supporting existing and new business processes, reporting, and data structures
Collaborate closely with finance leaders to understand business goals, identify gaps, and recommend system-driven improvements
Facilitate design reviews and solution walkthroughs with functional owners, subject matter experts, and end users
Present solution options with clear trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to support informed decision-making
Drive the delivery of system enhancements, new capabilities, and enterprise transformation initiatives
Participate in change management, user enablement, and post–go-live support activities

Who We Look For
Who We Are Looking For
Self-motivated, articulate, and results-driven, with a strong commitment to customer satisfaction
Passionate about delivering modern, cloud-based enterprise solutions that unlock business value
Comfortable balancing collaboration and independence in complex, fast-moving environments
Resourceful, proactive, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of ownership
Positive, adaptable, and dependable, able to perform effectively under tight timelines
Comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth organizations

Qualifications
5+ years of experience working with enterprise financial or ERP platforms, including solution design, configuration, implementation, and production support (Workday Financials is strongly prefered)
Deep understanding of finance and planning domains, including core financial management, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, projects, expenses, and supplier management
Strong experience translating business and functional requirements into sustainable, scalable system solutions
Proven expertise across the full application development lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, and support
Experience delivering large-scale ERP or enterprise cloud transformation initiatives
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work effectively across geographies, time zones, and cross-functional teams
Experience integrating ERP or finance platforms with third-party systems
Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to change and manage competing priorities
Strong technical project leadership and stakeholder management skills
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Build repeatable frameworks and processes instead of managing issues case by case.
Support the department in handling complex, high-priority or time-sensitive topics that require cross-business judgment and strong execution.

Translate complex business discussions into language that is:
clear enough for senior executives to make decisions;
practical enough for teams to understand and execute.

Serve as a trusted sparring partner who can challenge assumptions constructively while maintaining strong relationships with senior executives and stakeholders.

Develop a strong understanding of Tencent Games’ internal businesses, key stakeholders, decision-making processes and organizational context.
Build broad knowledge across investment, post-investment management, strategic partnerships, commercial collaboration and regional BD.
Apply sound interpersonal judgment and organizational sensitivity when handling complex stakeholder topics.

Actively explore and apply AI tools to improve research, analysis, knowledge management, workflow automation, document creation and decision support.
Identify opportunities to redesign existing business-management workflows with AI, rather than simply using AI to accelerate isolated tasks.
Turn recurring management work, effective prompts, workflows and institutional knowledge into reusable team capabilities.
Contribute to the development of the department’s AI Infra, knowledge base and organizational memory.

Strong strategic judgment, analytical capability and problem-solving skills.

Strong understanding of—or demonstrated ability to quickly learn—investment, commercial partnerships, business operations and organizational management.

jobs.title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav
Responsibilities
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

jobs.title: WorkBuddy-Agent Harness 研发工程师
jobs.description:

2.独立解决问题，提出原创性想法，从 0 到 1 驱动研究探索；同时拥有扎实的工程落地能力，打通从想法提出到落地实现的完整链路；
3.可针对全新问题定义合理的评测与验证标准，搭建配套评测数据集；立足真实业务场景，保证智能体能力在现实环境下有效可用；
4.包括但不限于以下研究方向：1）Harness Self‑Evolution 方向：研究 Harness 闭环自进化机制，自主迭代工具集、执行架构与多智能体协作范式，适配模型能力与业务场景演进；2）Context Engineering 方向：探索复杂场景下的上下文组织与编排，在模型窗口和 token efficiency 约束下引导模型聚焦关键信息，提升 Agent 任务表现；3）Multi‑Agent Coordination 方向：研究大规模分布式智能体协作，构建 Agent 集群化协作能力；4）Long‑term Memory 方向：研究 Agent 长期记忆、经验内化与自我迭代机制，形成稳定的行为模式与长期决策准则；5）Long‑Horizon 方向：研究长链路、稀疏反馈任务下的持续决策机制，降低长周期执行中的能力衰减；
5.包括但不限于以下工程方向：1）Harness Self‑Evolution 方向：搭建 Agent 自进化 SDK 与平台，实现智能体自主迭代与持续能力升级；2）Context Engineering 方向：优化 Agent 上下文与提示工程，提升复杂场景下的适配能力与任务表现；3）Evaluation 方向：建设 Agent 多维度评测体系、数据集与基准，支撑 Agent 效果迭代和自进化。

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容 
・アドベンチャーパート全体の設計・進行管理
ストーリーパート（会話、探索、選択肢など）の構成・演出・体験設計を担い、ゲームの物語体験を豊かにします。
・シナリオとの連携・ゲーム化の設計
原作や脚本と連携し、テキストベースの情報をゲーム体験としてどのように実装するか設計します。選択肢、分岐、演出、テンポなどを総合的に調整します。
・イベント演出・カメラ・アニメーションの設計指示
会話イベント中の演出（カメラワーク、モーション、SE、UI表示など）を指定し、シナリオの感情や意図をより魅力的に伝える演出を設計します。
・アドベンチャーUI/UXの設計
選択肢の見せ方、ログ表示、スキップ／巻き戻し、探索時のインタラクションなど、プレイヤーが快適に物語を楽しめるUI/UXを設計します。
・実装・検証・ブラッシュアップ
設計した仕様をエンジン上に組み込み、開発中に繰り返しテスト・修正を行い、ユーザー体験の質を高めます。
Job Description
・Overall Design and Production Management of Adventure Parts Lead the design, structure, and progress management of story-driven segments (dialogue, exploration, choices, etc.), creating immersive narrative experiences for players.
・Collaboration with Scenario Writers & Game Adaptation Design Work closely with original authors and scriptwriters to translate text-based content into compelling gameplay experiences. Design branching choices, event flow, pacing, and presentation to align with the narrative’s intent.
・Direction of Event Presentation, Camera, and Animation Specify event scene direction, including camera work, character motions, sound effects, and UI displays, to effectively convey the emotional beats and intentions of the story.
・Adventure UI/UX Design Design user interfaces and interactions—such as choice selection, log display, skip/rewind functions, and exploration interactions—that allow players to comfortably enjoy the narrative.
・Implementation, Testing, and Polish Implement designed specifications in the game engine, conduct iterative testing during development, and refine the user experience through repeated adjustments.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件
・アドベンチャーゲーム、ストーリーゲームにおける企画経験
・カットシーンやイベント演出の設計スキル
・テキスト・シナリオをゲーム体験に落とし込むための論理的な設計力
・UI/UX設計への理解と実務経験
・ゲームエンジンやスクリプトを使った実装・検証経験
・チームと連携できるコミュニケーション力とドキュメント作成能力
歓迎スキル
・ノベルゲーム、ビジュアルノベル系の制作経験
・マルチエンディングや分岐シナリオ設計経験
・音声収録やボイスディレクションへの関与経験
・海外スタジオや多言語対応に関する開発経験
Qualifications
・Experience in planning for adventure games or story-driven titles
・Skills in designing cutscenes and event presentations
・Strong logical design ability to adapt text/scenarios into gameplay
・Understanding and practical experience in UI/UX design
・Hands-on experience with implementation and testing using game engines and scripting tools
・Strong communication and documentation skills for effective teamwork Preferred Skills
・Experience in developing visual novels or novel-style games
・Experience designing branching scenarios or multi-ending structures
・Involvement in voice recording or voice direction
・Development experience with overseas studios or multilingual localization

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

ゲームの根幹となるルールや進行フロー、各種システム（成長、装備、スキル、経済など）を設計し、プレイヤー体験の中核を担います。

戦闘、育成、収集、経済など各種システムが相互に連携し、統一感あるゲーム体験となるように設計します。
・UX観点でのシステム設計
ユーザー視点での操作性・理解性を意識し、分かりやすく直感的なUI/UXを実現するための仕様設計を行います。
・バランス調整およびデータ設計
成長カーブ、報酬設計、リソースのインフレ管理など、数値やデータの設計・調整を行い、ゲームの長期的な面白さと持続性を支えます。

仕様や意図を明確にしたドキュメントを作成し、プログラマー、アーティスト、QAなど他職種との円滑な連携を図ります。
Job Description
・Design and Development of Core Game Systems Plan and build the fundamental rules, progression flow, and key systems (growth, equipment, skills, economy, etc.) that form the backbone of the player experience.
・Inter-System Integration Design Ensure combat, progression, collection, economy, and other systems interact cohesively to deliver a unified and engaging gameplay experience.
・System Design from a UX Perspective Design specifications that prioritize intuitive, easy-to-understand UI/UX, ensuring smooth operation and player comprehension.
・Balancing and Data Design Plan and adjust parameters such as growth curves, reward systems, and resource inflation control to maintain long-term engagement and game sustainability.
・Specification Documentation and Cross-Team Collaboration Create clear and detailed documentation of system specifications and intentions, facilitating smooth collaboration with programmers, artists, QA, and other disciplines.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件 
・アクションゲームやオンラインゲームにおけるゲームシステム設計の実務経験
・パラメータ設計、報酬設計、インフレ調整など、数値バランス設計のスキル
・ユーザビリティを意識したUX/UI設計経験
・他職種と協働できるコミュニケーション力と論理的なドキュメント作成能力
・スクリプトやアニメーション、ネットワークなどゲーム開発に関する基礎知識
・プレイテスト設計および、テスト結果に基づく改善調整スキル 歓迎スキル
・AAAタイトルや大型オンラインゲームでの開発経験
・データ分析を活用した継続的な改善プロセスの経験
・UNREALエンジンなどのゲーム開発ツールの使用経験
Qualifications
・Practical experience in designing game systems for action games or online games
・Skills in parameter design, reward structure planning, and inflation control for balanced gameplay
・Experience designing UX/UI with a focus on usability
・Strong communication skills and ability to create logical, clear documentation for cross-disciplinary work
・Foundational knowledge of game development, including scripting, animation, and networking
・Ability to design playtests and make improvements based on test results Preferred Skills

・Experience applying data analytics for continuous improvement
・Familiarity with game development tools such as Unreal Engine

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容

ゲームや映像作品の世界観、キャラクター、背景などのビジュアルコンセプトを作成し、作品全体のビジュアル方向性を視覚的に表現する。
2.  フォトリアルなキャラクターおよびエネミーデザイン
ゲーム内のキャラクターや敵キャラクターのデザインを担当し、キャラクターの性格や背景に基づいて個性的で魅力的なビジュアルを創り上げる。
3.  環境デザインと世界観の構築
ゲーム内のステージや環境、背景アートをデザインし、プレイヤーが没入できる世界観を提供する。
4.  ビジュアルスタイルガイドラインの策定
ゲーム全体のビジュアルスタイルを定め、キャラクター、エフェクト、背景などのアート要素が統一されるようにガイドラインを作成する。
5.  他部門との協力
ゲームデザイナーや3Dアーティストと連携し、ビジュアル要素がゲームプレイに適切に統合されるように調整する。
6.  外部協力会社への発注準備、指定書制作、アートの監修

Job Description
1. Creation of Photorealistic Visual Concepts
Develop visual concepts that express the overall visual direction of games or visual works, including the world, characters, and environments, with a photorealistic style.
2. Photorealistic Character and Enemy Design
Design in-game characters and enemies based on their personality and background, creating unique and visually compelling representations.
3. Environment Design and World-Building
Design in-game stages, environments, and background art to deliver an immersive world that enhances player engagement.
4. Development of Visual Style Guidelines
Establish visual style guidelines for the game to ensure consistency across all art elements, including characters, effects, and backgrounds.
5. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with game designers and 3D artists to ensure visual elements are well-integrated into the gameplay experience.
6. Art Supervision and Documentation for External Partners
Prepare briefing materials and specifications for outsourcing, and supervise art production by external vendors to maintain quality and consistency.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件
1.  コンセプトアート経験
ゲーム業界でのコンセプトアート経験（AAAタイトル経験者優遇）。キャラクター、環境、エフェクトのデザインに関する豊富な知識と実績。
2.  デザインツールの使用スキル
PhotoshopやIllustratorなどの主要なデザインツールを使いこなすスキル。
3.  3Dアートの基本的理解
3Dソフトウェア（Maya、ZBrushなど）の基本的な知識があり、3Dアートとの連携ができる能力。
4.  チームワークとコミュニケーション能力
他のアーティストやディレクターと円滑に連携し、プロジェクトを進めるための優れたコミュニケーションスキル。
5.  フィードバックへの柔軟な対応
チームメンバーやクライアントからのフィードバックを適切に受け入れ、柔軟に改善・修正できる能力。

Requirements
1. Concept Art Experience
Experience in concept art within the gaming industry (experience with AAA titles is a plus). Strong knowledge and a proven track record in designing characters, environments, and effects.
2. Proficiency with Design Tools
Advanced skills in using major design tools such as Photoshop and Illustrator.
3. Basic Understanding of 3D Art
Fundamental knowledge of 3D software (e.g., Maya, ZBrush) and the ability to collaborate effectively with 3D artists.
4. Teamwork and Communication Skills
Excellent communication skills to work smoothly with other artists and directors, contributing to overall project success.
5. Flexibility in Responding to Feedback
Ability to accept and incorporate feedback from team members and clients with a flexible and constructive attitude.

4. Playtesting and Feedback Analysis

jobs.description:

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容 
１、ゲーム内のサウンドシステム開発 リアルタイムオーディオシステム、音声再生制御、環境音処理、7.1.4 Dolby Atmos対応3Dサウンド機能など、ゲーム体験を強化する音響システムをディレクターや実機の要件を元に設計・実装します。
２、ミドルウェア（Wwise/ADX2等）のUE5への組み込みと独自カスタマイズ オーディオミドルウェアを活用し、UE5との連携・拡張機能の開発・実装を担当します。
３、サウンドデザイナーとの連携とツール開発 サウンドデザイナーが効率よく実装・調整できるように、オーディオエディタやデバッグツールの開発・保守を行います。
４、サウンドデータの最適化 ハードウェアリソースやパフォーマンスを考慮し、メモリ管理、音声データ・ストリーミング処理の設計および最適化を行います。 ５、オーディオイベントの制御実装 ゲームプレイに連動したサウンドイベントの制御や、キャラクター・UI・環境音など多岐にわたるオーディオ制御ロジックを設計、実装します。
６、プロシージャルオーディオの研究開発 社内技研との協力のもと、AI等駆使しつつUE5でのプロシージャルオーディオエンジンの設計・実装
７、ペリフェラルの振動設計および実装
Job Description
・In-game sound system development Design and implement audio systems that enhance the game experience—such as real-time audio systems, sound playback control, environmental sound processing, and 7.1.4 Dolby Atmos–compatible 3D sound—based on director instructions and hardware requirements.
・Middleware (Wwise / ADX2, etc.) integration into UE5 with custom extensions Utilize audio middleware to handle UE5 integration, develop extended features, and perform custom implementations.
・Collaboration with sound designers and tool development Develop and maintain audio editors and debugging tools to help sound designers efficiently implement and fine-tune audio assets.
・Sound data optimization Optimize memory usage, design streaming and audio data processing, and improve performance with hardware resource constraints in mind.
・Audio event control implementation Design and implement control logic for sound events tied to gameplay, including character sounds, UI audio, environmental sounds, and other diverse audio categories.
・Procedural audio research and development In collaboration with the company’s R&D division, design and implement procedural audio engines for UE5, leveraging AI and other advanced techniques.
・Peripheral vibration design and implementation

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件
・サウンドプログラマーまたはゲームプログラマーとしての実務経験
・C++やC#などのプログラミングスキル ・オーディオミドルウェア（Wwise、ADX2等）を使用した開発経験
・サウンドデザイナーとの協業経験、またはそれに準ずる理解
・コンソールまたはPCにてAA以上のタイトル開発経験
・UE5実装知識 歓迎スキル
・マルチプラットフォーム（家庭用ゲーム機・PC・モバイル）向けのサウンド開発経験
・リアルタイムサウンド処理、DSPや音響プラグイン制作の専門知識
・DAWやオーディオツールに関する技術的理解およびスクリプト制作
・波形解析知識
Qualifications
・Professional experience as a sound programmer or game programmer
・Programming skills in C++ and/or C#
・Experience developing with audio middleware (Wwise, ADX2, etc.)
・Experience collaborating with sound designers, or equivalent understanding
・Development experience on console or PC titles at AA scale or above
・Working knowledge of UE5 implementation Preferred Skills
・Experience in audio development for multiple platforms (consoles, PC, mobile)
・Expertise in real-time audio processing, DSP, and audio plugin development
・Technical understanding of DAWs and audio tools, including script creation

jobs.description:
部署紹介/Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS は、物語性の高いストーリー、没入感のあるゲームプレイ、最先端のテクノロジーを駆使し、ゲーム開発をアートとサイエンスの融合として追求し続けています。世界中のプレイヤー、そしてあらゆるデバイスに次世代のゲームエクスペリエンスを提供することを使命としています。
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1. テンセントLighSpeedスタジオの次世代コンソールゲームプロジェクトにおいて、製品特性に適した音声デザインおよび実施プランを策定する。
2.音声デザインの計画に基づき、要件の調整、リソースの制作および統合、テスト検証と最適化を行い、ゲームの最終的なサウンド品質を管理する。
Job Description
1. Formulate sound design and implementation plans suitable for product features for Tencent LightSpeed Studio's next-generation console game projects.
2. Based on the sound design plan, coordinate requirements, create and integrate resources, conduct testing and optimization, and manage the final sound quality of the game.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募資格
1.5年以上のゲーム音声制作経験があり、AAAクオリティの高品質ゲーム音声デザインにフルタイムで参加経験があること。ゲーム音声制作の全体フローに精通。
2.高いサウンドデザイン能力を持ち、音声録音、処理、ミキシングを効率よく行える。DAWソフト（Digital Audio Workstation）を1つ以上使いこなすことができ、エフェクターやシンセサイザーなどの音響設計ツールの実用的なスキルを有する。
3.サウンドデザインとパイプライン構築能力に優れ、Wwiseなどの音声ミドルウェアを使いこなせる。UnityやUEなどのゲームエンジンの基本操作に精通している。
4.日本語必須、英語か中国語でコミュニケーションできる方大歓迎。
5.プロジェクト管理スキルがあり、チーム内外で調整してニーズを期限内に確実に実行できる。
6.熱心なゲーマーで、ゲームとゲーム音声に対する情熱を持ち、ゲームプレイと音声デザインの関係について独自の理解がある。
7.独立してプロジェクトを進める能力と、チームで協力して仕事を進める能力の両方があり、学習能力とチームワークを重視する。
Requirements
1. Over 5 years of experience in game sound production, with full-time participation in high-quality, AAA-standard game sound design, and a comprehensive understanding of the entire game sound production process.
2. Strong sound design skills, including efficient audio recording, processing, and mixing capabilities. Proficiency in using at least one DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) software and practical skills in sound design tools such as effects processors and synthesizers.
3. Excellent abilities in sound design and pipeline construction, with proficiency in audio middleware such as Wwise. Familiarity with basic operations of game engines such as Unity and Unreal Engine (UE).
4. Japanese fluency is required; candidates who can communicate in English or Chinese are highly welcomed.
5. Project management skills with the ability to coordinate within and outside the team to meet needs on time.
6. A passionate gamer with a deep interest in game sound and a unique understanding of the relationship between gameplay and sound design.
7. The ability to independently lead projects and work collaboratively as part of a team, with a focus on learning and teamwork.

・難易度曲線と進行設計
ゲームの序盤から終盤にかけての難易度の変化や学習曲線を意識し、プレイヤーが自然にスキルアップできるようにステージ構成を調整します。
・ナラティブやシステムとの整合性の確保
ストーリー展開やゲームシステムと整合性を持たせながら、シームレスに進行するレベル体験を設計します。
・プレイテストとレベルチューニング
ユーザーテストや開発中のプレイを通じて、レベル構成の面白さ・導線の分かりやすさ・テンポ感などを検証し、継続的に改善します。
・ツールを用いたマップ作成と実装作業
エンジン内ツールやレベルエディタを使用して、実際のマップ作成・配置を行い、仕様を実装まで担当します。
Job Description
・Design and Construction of In-Game Level Layouts Plan and create gameplay spaces that include stage structures, enemy placement, gimmicks, player routes, and exploration elements, crafting engaging experiences for players.
・Difficulty Curve and Progression Design Adjust stage compositions to ensure a natural learning curve and smooth skill progression from the beginning to the end of the game.
・Ensuring Narrative and System Consistency Design seamless level experiences that align with story progression and game systems.
・Playtesting and Level Tuning Conduct user tests and in-development play sessions to verify the fun factor, clarity of routes, and pacing of levels, making continuous improvements based on feedback.
・Map Creation and Implementation Using Tools Use in-engine tools and level editors to create maps, place objects, and handle implementation in accordance with specifications.

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
1. 物語およびキャラクター設定の構築
ゲームのストーリー全体やキャラクターの背景、個性を設計し、物語のテーマやメッセージを明確にします。
2. シーンやイベントのデザイン
ゲーム内のカットシーンやイベントシーンの演出を企画し、物語の展開を支えるシーンを細かくデザインします。プレイヤーが物語に没入できるよう、感動的なシナリオを描きます。
3. 台詞およびテキストの執筆
キャラクターの台詞やナレーション、プレイヤーが出会うテキストの執筆を担当し、キャラクターの個性や物語の進行を効果的に表現します。
4. 分岐ストーリーおよびインタラクションの設計
プレイヤーの選択や行動がストーリーに影響を与える分岐や選択肢を設計し、プレイヤーの没入感を高めます。
5. 他部門との連携
アート、アニメーション、サウンドなどの他部門と協力し、ナラティブ要素が視覚的、聴覚的に伝わるよう調整します。シーンの演出やカットシーンに合わせたストーリー構成を実現します。
Job Description
1. Story and Character Development
- Design the overall game story, character backgrounds, and personalities, clarifying the themes and messages of the narrative.
2. Scene and Event Design
- Plan and design the direction of in-game cutscenes and event scenes, supporting story progression with detailed and impactful scenes to enhance player immersion and create emotional scenarios.
3. Dialogue and Text Writing
- Responsible for writing character dialogues, narration, and in-game text that players encounter, effectively conveying character traits and advancing the story. 4. Design of Branching Stories and Interactions
- Create branching storylines and choices that are influenced by player decisions and actions, increasing player engagement and immersion.
5. Collaboration with Other Departments
- Work closely with departments such as art, animation, and sound to ensure that narrative elements are conveyed visually and audibly, aligning the story structure with scene direction and cutscenes.

応募資格
ゲームまたはエンターテインメント業界でのナラティブデザイン経験（優遇）
ストーリーテリング、キャラクター作成、台詞執筆のスキル
プレイヤーの感情を引き出すストーリーテリング能力
プレイヤーの行動に基づいたインタラクティブなストーリー設計ができる方
他部門と連携しながら物語を形作るためのコミュニケーションスキル

- Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with other departments to shape the narrative

You will ensure that player-controlled animations respond instantly while maintaining natural and realistic movement.

3. Providing technical support for motion capture-related challenges.

・Mayaでのリギング・スキニングの経験
・RBF（Radial Basis Function）技術の知識
・ML Deformerに関する経験

Understanding and hands-on experience with retargeting
Experience implementing motion assets in Unreal Engine
Experience using Control Rig
Experience using Animation Blueprint
Experience with State Machines, Blend Spaces, and Transitions
Experience with version control tools such as Perforce
Experience using motion capture systems

Preferred Skills
Experience with Motion Matching
Rigging and skinning experience in Maya
Knowledge of RBF (Radial Basis Function) technology

チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。
柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し、ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。
LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.
The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
仕事内容
チームのリギング関連の責任者として、アニメーターをサポートし、外部ベンダーと連携しながら高品質なリギングの制作を担当します。
具体的な業務内容は以下の通りです：
①既存のリグ案を検証し、プロジェクトにおける最終的なリグ仕様・方針を策定する
②外部ベンダーによるリグ作業の品質を管理し、プロジェクトの要件を満たすようにする
③リグ関連のツールを開発・保守する
④MocapからMaya、最終的にUnreal Engineへの実装フローにおける課題をツール開発によって解決する（※オプション）
⑤既存のツールをベースに、LiveLinkのツールフローを構築・保守する（※オプション）

Job Description
As the Rigging Lead, you will support animators and collaborate with external vendors to produce high-quality rigs. Your main responsibilities include:
1. Reviewing existing rig proposals and establishing the final rig specifications and direction for the project.
2. Managing the quality of rigging work provided by external vendors to ensure it meets project requirements.
3. Developing and maintaining rigging-related tools.
4. (Optional) Solving issues in the pipeline from motion capture to Maya to Unreal Engine through tool development.
5. (Optional) Building and maintaining the LiveLink tool workflow based on existing tools.

応募資格/Who We Look For
応募条件
必須スキル：
・Mayaにおけるリギング関連ツールの開発経験
・Mayaを用いたリギングの実務経験（3年）
・Perforce等のバージョン管理ツールの使用経験
歓迎スキル（オプション）：
・Unreal Engine用プラグインの開発経験
・モーションキャプチャシステムの使用経験
・補助骨、Blendshape、Pose Driver等のMayaおよびUEへの実装経験

Application Requirements
Required Skills:
Experience developing rigging-related tools in Maya
At least 3 years of hands-on rigging experience using Maya
Experience using version control tools such as Perforce

Preferred Skills (Optional):
Experience developing plugins for Unreal Engine
Experience using motion capture systems
Experience implementing helper bones, blendshapes, and pose drivers in both Maya and Unreal Engine

一緒に働く魅力/Why Join Us?
勤務地
大阪（JR大阪駅JP TOWER OSAKA）、東京（虎ノ門ヒルズビジネスタワー）※希望に添います
賃金
年収額：応相談（昇給/賞与あり）
※経験・スキル等を考慮し、当社規定により優遇します。
※一般社員の場合、固定残業代月35時間分が含まれます。
管理職の場合、固定残業代10時間分が含まれます。
労働時間・休日
就業時間 09:30 ~ 18:30　 休憩時間 60分
フレックスタイムあり
完全週休２日制（土日・祝日）
有給休暇：入社初年度は、入社月により期間按分付与。在籍年数踏まえて最大22日
年末年始休暇（12/30～1/3）
病気休暇（有給）：12日/年（有給休暇とは別途付与）
福利厚生

健康保険 、雇用保険、 労災保険、 厚生年金保険、 総合福祉団体定期保険（GTL）
業務災害安心総合保険（GPA）、団体長期障害所得補償保険（GLTD）
海外旅行保険
＜各種手当＞
通勤手当(上限5万円/月) 、通信手当（上限1万円/月）、 自己啓発手当（上限2万円/月）、 平日に出社した場合食事補助1800円/日、定期健診手当（上限7万5千円/年1回）
＜支援制度・その他待遇＞

jobs.title: 产品管理Agent开发架构师
jobs.description:
1.深入分析销售与架构师的日常工作链路和痛点，梳理产品选型、配置推荐、询价、折扣策略等核心场景，识别适合由 AI Agent 提效或自动化的环节；
2.负责 Agent 的产品与技术方案设计并落地，包括平台选型、模型选型、skills 开发、多 Agent 架构、工具调用、知识库、安全控制、评测体系及可观测性建设；
3.建立 Agent 评测体系，持续优化准确率、任务完成率、响应速度、调用成本和用户体验；
4.跟踪并判断大模型及 Agent 技术的发展，将真正有业务价值的新技术引入产品。

jobs.title: 人力资源平台部-AI应用开发工程师
jobs.description:
1.负责HR领域大模型及AI Agent在业务场景中的应用落地，牵头重点AI项目的方案设计、推进交付、效果优化与持续迭代；
2.负责HR领域业务系统的AI原子能力建设，推动相关能力标准化、组件化沉淀，并支持不同业务场景复用；
3.跟进AI领域前沿技术，评估并引入适配的技术方案，推动其在实际项目中落地。

jobs.title: 代号：Craft -高级AI产品经理（AI生成游戏）
jobs.description:
1.负责 AI 生成游戏平台的整体产品体验与版本演进，把控产品方向、需求优先级与交付质量，对产品体验结果负责；
2.设计从创意输入 → 策划生成 → 构建可玩 → 发布分发的全链路体验，持续提升创作成功率与迭代效率；
3.建立分层用户策略，针对不同能力层创作者设计差异化的引导路径与能力呈现；
4.负责 AI 与人协同的生产机制设计：执行前的方案确认、执行中的进度可见、完成后的结果验证，让 AI 生成过程可控、可预期；
5.主导 Agent Harness 的产品化设计：定义多 Agent 分工与编排策略、上下文工程方案、工具调用与执行反馈机制，把 Agent 能力沉淀为稳定可复用的产品架构；
6.规划垂类模型能力建设路径：从数据资产积累、后训练／微调方向选择到效果验证，与算法团队共同定义自研模型的目标与边界；
7.建立生成质量评估体系：定义分层验收标准与标准题库，让生成质量可量化、可跨版本对比，并支撑模型迭代的效果判断；
8.搭建数据指标体系，以创作成功率、迭代收敛效率、作品完成度与分享率等结果性指标驱动产品与模型优化；
9.持续跟踪基础模型与 Agent 技术演进，判断能力边界变化对产品策略的影响，推动技术能力转化为产品竞争力。

jobs.title: 代号：Craft · 高级关卡策划（AI 生成游戏）
jobs.description:
1.与美术团队紧密配合，设计并制作高品质标杆关卡，建立平台的关卡品质标准线，向创作者与行业展示 AI 生成游戏可达到的场景与体验水准；
2.主导关卡设计知识的结构化 —— 将空间布局规则、玩家动线与引导、节奏起伏模型、难度曲线、探索与奖励分布等专业方法转化为 AI Agent 可理解执行的结构化知识，构建关卡领域生成知识库；
3.设计关卡生成的品质评估维度 —— 空间合理性、动线通畅性、节奏张弛、难度递进与可完成性，建立可复用的关卡验收标准与评测用例；
4.制作覆盖主流品类的官方关卡模板与场景模块库，采用模块化设计（关卡模块 + 场景组件），降低 AI 生成复杂度与创作者上手门槛；
5.与 Agent 团队协作打磨关卡生成管线，通过 Prompt 策略、知识规范与生成结果诊断，持续提升关卡生成的成功率与可玩性；
6.建立关卡资产与场景搭建的规范标准，推动关卡内容在生成、编辑、运行各环节的一致性与可复用性。

jobs.title: 代号：Craft · 高级战斗策划（AI 生成游戏）
jobs.description:
1.与美术、动作团队紧密配合，设计并调优高品质标杆战斗系统，建立平台的战斗手感标准线，展示 AI 生成游戏可达到的战斗体验水准；
2.主导战斗设计知识的结构化 —— 将战斗节奏模型、技能设计范式、数值平衡公式、打击感构成要素、敌人 AI 行为逻辑等专业方法转化为 AI Agent 可理解执行的结构化知识，构建战斗领域生成知识库；
3.设计战斗生成的品质评估维度 —— 技能组合平衡性、数值曲线合理性、战斗节奏与手感标准、挑战强度递进，建立可复用的战斗验收标准与评测用例；
4.制作覆盖主流品类的战斗模板与战斗组件库（角色、技能、Buff、敌人、AI 行为），采用模块化设计降低 AI 生成复杂度与创作者调优门槛；
5.与 Agent 团队协作打磨战斗生成管线，通过 Prompt 策略、数值规范与生成结果诊断，持续提升战斗生成的可玩性与平衡度；
6.建立战斗配置与数值体系的规范标准，让战斗参数可被创作者直观理解与安全调整。

jobs.title: 代号：Craft · 高级玩法策划（AI 生成游戏）
jobs.description:
1.负责标杆游戏与官方模板的内容规划与品类布局，明确产出目标与优先级，验证并展示平台的生成能力上限；
2.带领并管理玩法制作团队：拆解任务、分配产能、把控进度与质量，建立高效的协作流程与产出节奏，对团队整体交付的数量、质量与效率负责；
3.建立游戏品质标准与评估体系 —— 定义不同品类（休闲、益智、动作、模拟等）的可玩性标准与验收维度，形成可执行的评审清单与质量门槛，让品质判断可传递、可复核；
4.主导玩法设计知识的结构化 —— 将游戏机制设计、系统循环、成长体系、数值框架等玩法经验，转化为 AI Agent 可理解执行的结构化描述（策划案模板、设计模式库、参数配置规范），直接提升 AI 的玩法生成质量；
5.沉淀可复用的生产方法论 —— 将标杆产出过程中的有效经验提炼为模板、SOP 与最佳实践，让团队新成员能快速达到品质基线，实现产能可复制；
6.基于用户测试与生成 Case 分析，持续优化玩法知识库的覆盖度与准确度，提升 AI 在各品类的生成成功率与可玩性；
7.与 Agent、引擎团队协作反哺产品 —— 把内容生产中发现的能力短板转化为明确的产品需求与优化方向。

jobs.title: 代号：Craft-高级工程师-Agentic Engineer
jobs.description:

5.基于改造后的工作流，总结并推广最佳实践，为团队提供可复用的方法论与工具支持。

jobs.title: 腾讯云-可观测与运维平台高级研发工程师（深圳/杭州/北京/上海）
jobs.description:

2.数据基础设施研发：负责高并发指标、日志、链路（Metrics, Log, Trace） 海量数据流水线的泛在采集、高性能多维存储与计算组件研发，持续优化系统性能与稳定性；
3.智能运维能力构建：利用AI重构并升级海量告警智能降噪、自适应动态拓扑、智能根因定位（RCA）及ChatOps交互式运维等核心产品能力，实现端到端智能闭环。

jobs.title: 腾讯云-应用安全工程师
jobs.description:
1.具备安全管理经验，熟悉红线、安全规范、安全度量、安全方案跟踪和落地；
2.需有良好的沟通能力和协调能力，能够深入产品线产研流程，理解安全需求，协调内外资源，解决安全风险，并具备一定的风险前瞻意识；

7.岗位可 base 北京、深圳、杭州。

jobs.title: 腾讯云-智慧零售-行业解决方案-（AI数智化方向-FDE Consultant）-深圳
jobs.description:
1.AI 数智化方案构建与落地：结合前沿 AI 技术（大模型、智能体等）及腾讯云核心产品能力，针对营销数字化、门店运营、客户体验、办公协同等场景，打造具有针对性和创新性的 AI 零售解决方案，并推进方案在实际项目中的高质量落地。
2.行业标杆打造与方法论沉淀：敏锐捕捉行业趋势，总结并提炼基于 AI 的零售数智化转型方法论。配合将客户的定制化诉求转化为内部产品的优化建议，反哺产品团队持续迭代。
3.零售业务战略洞察：深入调研重点消费零售客户，从企业数字化转型和业务增长的全局视角出发，快速诊断业务痛点，并输出高视角的战略规划与解决方案。
4.全球化客户深度经营：负责对接国内外头部企业或具备出海业务的企业客户，能够使用纯熟的英文与全球总部及核心决策层（C-Level）进行同频对话与方案宣讲，促成战略合作。

jobs.title: 腾讯云-智慧零售-零售行业技术咨询架构师（FDE Consultant）
jobs.description:
岗位背景：零售行业技术线涵盖技术架构的售前、售中、客户成功等职能，AI时代下业务转型升级成为核心命题，本岗位定位为零售行业技术线负责人的“外脑”与“右手”——助力业务看方向、出思路、做表达，承担对外宣讲与影响力输出的关键任务。

岗位价值：此岗位是腾讯云零售团队的“智慧输出端”——你不需要带团队，也不需要做交付，你要做的是让技术线“想得更清楚、讲得更自信、走得更远”。如果您热爱零售行业、喜欢研究前沿科技、擅长用PPT讲故事、享受站在台上的感觉，这个岗位会给您很大的舞台，期待您的加入！

任职要求：
1. 战略思考伙伴——“看得更远”
•主动跟踪零售行业发展趋势、科技前沿动态（如AI Agent、大模型、Agentic Workflow、数字孪生等），定期为技术线提供行业洞察与战略参考。
•协助梳理业务转型升级的路径图，帮助对内对外讲清楚“为什么是这个方向”。
•参与零售行业重大项目的战略复盘与方向对齐，沉淀可复用的行业判断框架。
2. 对外宣讲搭档——“讲得更响”
•熟练制作高质量PPT，配合负责人参与客户交流、行业峰会、合作伙伴沟通等外出宣讲场景，提供现场宣讲支持。
•将复杂的技术方案翻译为客户和管理层听得懂、记得住的语言，提升负责人的对外影响力。
3. 前沿科技顾问——“跟得上”
•深度研究AI大模型等前沿科技在零售行业的应用场景，输出科技应用分析报告与落地建议。
•为售前、售中、交付团队提供前沿科技赋能培训，提升团队整体科技认知水平。
•跟踪国内外零售科技厂商产品动态，保持横向视野。
4. 内容资产沉淀者——“留得住”
•沉淀零售行业科技转型方法论，建立可复用的宣讲材料、行业洞察、技术解读等知识资产库。
•协助负责人整理内部汇报材料、战略建议书、行业方案等关键文档。
•形成面向客户、合作伙伴、内部的标准化宣讲内容，支持团队持续复用。
5. 跨文化协作支持
•英语口语及书面表达流畅（达到母语级沟通水平），可支持负责人参与Global团队交流。
•跟踪海外零售行业科技趋势与最佳实践，将国际经验本土化落地。
•必要时支持负责人参与英文宣讲、国际展会、海外客户交流等场景。

jobs.title: 腾讯云-服务器硬件高级工程师
jobs.description:
1.主导腾讯云自研服务器（通用计算/Agentic AI/自研板卡）的硬件架构设计，包括主板、背板、电源、散热及互连拓扑等子系统的定义与优化；
2.负责面向云场景的PCIe板卡（如智能网卡、存储压缩卡等）硬件设计与研发，满足高性能计算与存储需求；
3.基于业务负载特性（计算/存储/网络）进行器件选型与方案权衡，输出完整的架构规格书与设计需求文档；
4.跟踪CPU、内存、PCIe/CXL、NIC、NVMe等关键器件的技术演进，推动LPDDR6、PCIe 6.0/7.0、CXL、液冷等新技术的预研与落地；
5.完成原理图与PCB Layout设计及评审，主导信号完整性(SI)和电源完整性(PI)的设计与优化；
6.设计供电(VRM/PDB)、时钟、复位、BMC/带外管理等核心电路，完成关键器件选型与参数验证；
7.制定硬件测试验证计划，主导EVT/DVT/PVT各阶段调试，解决硬件设计缺陷与验证问题；
8.执行信号完整性、电源质量、可靠性（HALT/HASS/高低温/振动）等全维度测试验证；
9.协同结构与热设计团队，完成风冷/液冷散热方案及机械结构的适配与优化；
10.与软件/固件（BIOS/BMC/OS/FPGA）、数据中心基础设施、采购供应链团队深度协作；
11.支持现网硬件故障分析(FA)、根因定位及改进方案落地，降低现网故障率。

jobs.description:
1.负责 DataBuddy 数据应用产品线的整体规划、roadmap 与版本迭代，覆盖可视化分析看板、智能分析、 Agent应用开发等应用模块；深度联动 语义层、数据知识、元数据与数据血缘底层能力，打通从数据治理到数据价值落地的全链路；
2.承接大模型与大数据融合趋势，负责 DataBuddy 智能问数、自然语言转 SQL、语义化分析、智能归因、指标解读、报表自动生成等 AI 应用场景设计；
3.结合腾讯云向量数据库、知识图谱、本体语义能力，优化智能问数准确率、报表自动生成、指标智能解读等核心体验，解决企业“数据看懂难、用起来难、分析门槛高”的核心痛点，打造差异化智能数据应用能力；
4.基于本体建模和语义建模，统一业务语义，让数据先"看得懂、可分析"，再据此支撑智能决策，最终驱动业务动作落地执行，打通"数据分析—智能决策—行动执行"的完整闭环；
5.独立完成需求调研、竞品分析、产品架构设计、原型输出、PRD撰写、需求评审、研发跟进、灰度上线、数据复盘全流程工作。联动研发、算法、测试、解决方案，推进需求落地，持续优化产品功能体验、性能指标、场景覆盖率。同时监控产品核心指标（用户活跃度、自助分析使用率、智能问数通过率、客户交付效率），驱动产品持续迭代优化；
6.对接零售、游戏、教育、汽车等重点行业大客户，挖掘经营分析、数据运营、自助分析等真实需求，完成需求拆解、方案设计、POC 与项目落地；沉淀标准化的行业解决方案、最佳实践与模板资产（行业分析方法论、分析模型、分析模板），支撑售前攻坚与规模化复制；
7.跟踪国内外数据 Agent 行业趋势与竞品动态，提炼 DataBuddy 差异化优势；输出白皮书、方案手册、宣讲材料与教学案例，支撑产品宣发、客户培训与行业落地；
8.该岗位可 base 深圳、北京、上海、杭州。

jobs.title: 营销与交易产品部-云Mall 高级产品经理（电商交易平台方向）
jobs.description:
1.负责云Mall产品线的整体产品规划，包括版本路线图、优先级决策，从电商交易全链路（商品发现→决策转化→交易履约→售后服务）出发定义产品核心能力和差异化打法；
2.主导交易核心模块的产品架构设计，包括商品管理、订单管理、结算引擎、库存管理、营销活动、售后服务等，设计可复用的产品化底座，支撑私有化部署与SaaS双模式交付；
3.从AI原生视角重新定义交易平台的产品形态，思考当AI Agent成为交易参与者时，交易平台的产品架构、交互模式、数据开放方式需要发生怎样的根本性变化，而非在现有产品上叠加AI功能；
4.前瞻性规划面向AI Agent时代的交易基建，定义交易平台如何适配"人+Agent"混合交易场景——商品如何被机器理解、交易流程如何被协议化调用、履约能力如何对外开放；
5.深度洞察品牌客户需求，区分大品牌与中腰部客户的差异化诉求，将客户需求转化为可落地的产品方案；
6.持续跟踪行业趋势与竞品动态（如业内头部标杆产品的AI化演进，AI Agent/MCP等新范式对电商交易场的重塑），转化为产品策略输入。

jobs.title: 解决方案架构师
jobs.description:
1.深度挖掘B端客户需求并定制解决方案，通过调研行业场景痛点和拆解AI应用核心需求，输出涵盖技术架构、功能规划、实施路径及成本预算的可落地方案，有效支撑商业签约转化；
2.作为客户与内部团队的技术桥梁，联动研发（算法/工程）、产品团队，将定制方案拆解为具体开发任务，制定项目排期并全程把控进度、质量与交付时效，及时解决落地过程中的技术与协作难题；
3.担任客户核心技术对接人，提供售前演示、技术答疑及售后运维支持，高效处理项目落地中的各类问题，持续提升客户满意度并推动复购与转介绍；
4.策划并输出AI技术相关案例、白皮书及行业干货内容，积极参与展会、技术沙龙、客户交流会等活动，通过方案宣讲与品牌曝光吸引潜在客户合作；
5.沉淀行业解决方案模板与技术组件库，优化方案输出效率；跟踪AI前沿技术（如大模型、多模态等）并将其融入方案设计，构建差异化竞争优势；
6.为销售团队提供方案培训、竞品分析及常见问题解答，协助优化销售话术与推广素材，全面提升团队技术型销售能力。

jobs.title: 设计智能体- Ardot产品经理
jobs.description:
1.负责设计智能体Ardot的产品规划与全生命周期管理，从需求调研到上线迭代的全流程把控；
2.深入理解B端客户需求，与腾讯云WorkBuddy团队紧密协作，设计并优化AI驱动的设计辅助功能；
3.协调跨部门资源（包括研发、设计、测试等），推动产品方案高效落地，确保项目按时交付；
4.通过数据分析与用户反馈，持续改进产品体验，提升设计智能体的易用性与工作效率；
5.制定产品迭代计划，平衡用户体验与技术可行性，达成业务增长与用户满意度目标；
6.参与竞品分析，洞察行业趋势，为产品设计提供前瞻性策略建议。

jobs.title: 轻游梦工坊-高级玩法策划（AI游戏生成）
jobs.description:
1.作为团队的玩法设计专家，运用AI工具快速迭代设计创新型休闲游戏玩法原型，打造AI游戏生成平台的标杆游戏作品，验证并展示平台的生成能力；
2.主导游戏玩法知识的结构化工作——将游戏机制设计、系统循环、成长体系、数值框架等玩法设计经验，编写为AI Agent可理解的结构化描述（如策划案模板、设计模式库、参数配置规范等），直接提升AI的玩法生成质量；
3.负责AI生成游戏的玩法品质评估与调优，定义不同品类游戏（休闲、益智、动作、模拟等）的可玩性标准与评估方法，建立品类适配的最佳实践；
4.制作官方游戏模板与玩法案例库，系统性地展示平台的关键特性与能力边界，降低创作者的学习成本；
5.参与AI生成游戏的迭代修改体验优化——设计"用户自然语言修改玩法→AI理解并增量修改代码"的交互流程与提示策略，确保迭代修改不破坏已有功能；
6.基于用户测试数据和生成Case分析，持续优化玩法知识库的覆盖度与准确度，提升AI在各品类的生成成功率与可玩性。

jobs.title: 轻量云OpenClaw AI Agent 高级工程师
jobs.description:
1.负责开发者和中小企业场景下智能 Agent 系统的设计、开发与优化；
2.结合 Lighthouse 与 OpenClaw 场景，参与 Agent 的部署、调优、评测与问题排查；
3.负责提示词、工具调用、交互流程与 Agent 技能设计，提升任务执行效果；
4.负责 RAG / Agentic RAG 及企业知识库接入与优化；
5.将大模型能力封装为可复用的工具与组件，沉淀 AI 应用能力；
6.编写技术文档，推动方案落地，并与产品、业务团队协作完成交付。

jobs.title: 轻量云后台研发负责人
jobs.description:
1.负责开发者及中小企业场景下AI Agent 应用相关领域的技术主导，确保系统的高可用性、可扩展性与技术领先性；
2.深度结合腾讯云计算产品 与 OpenClaw 及相关生态，带领团队解决 Agent 在用户核心业务场景下的核心难点；
3.负责研发团队的日常管理及技术梯队建设，激发团队创新活力，提升整体产出效率；
4.紧跟全球 AI 领域新趋势，将前沿应用/算法/架构转化为业务增长点；
5.深度参与业务决策，与合作团队紧密配合，推动 AI 原生应用从 Demo 到商业化落地的全生命周期管理。

jobs.title: 边缘AI推理研发工程师（深圳）
jobs.description:
推理方向：
1.面向低延迟交互场景打造极致低延迟推理系统，通过调度、传输、计算优化，深度优化端到端推理延迟；
2.设计开发一站式 Serverless AI 推理平台，结合边缘云 Serverless 生态支持一站式边缘 AI 应用，提升实时语音交互等低延迟 AI 应用场景的用户体验；
缓存方向：
1.面向低延迟交互场景打造 KVCache 缓存系统，通过 KVCache 卸载、传输、压缩优化，深度优化端到端推理延迟，提升实时语音交互等低延迟 AI 应用场景的用户体验；
2.设计开发边缘推理 KVCache 平台，结合边缘云 Serverless 生态支持一站式边缘 AI 应用，通过 KVCache 复用、分层存储、跨请求共享等技术提升推理性能。

jobs.title: 金融科技-AI测试开发专家架构师 - 智能研发方向(深圳)
jobs.description:
1.主导部门软件工程智能化技术方向规划，制定智能测试、缺陷检测、精准回归等方向的技术路线图并推动落地；
2.设计并推动金融研发质效智能体落地，搭建AI驱动的质量保障体系，建立可度量的效能提升闭环；
3.攻克大模型在金融测试场景的核心技术难题（如幻觉治理、领域适配、长链路推理）；
4.参与团队技术人才培养，跨团队协同推动智能研发能力在多业务线的落地。

jobs.title: 金融科技-Agent架构设计与推理性能优化工程师
jobs.description:
1.· 负责Agent harness的设计与平台 Agent 开发，结合统一Agent框架、标准LLM服务，扩展自定义工具、沙箱 、Agent 互调通信，完成业务功能目标；
2.· 围绕工具的场景，定义量化指标，并结合轨迹的合理性，整体优化 Agent 工作效率与效果；
3.· 优化模型推理性能，包括缓存命中率、私有化推理集群的调度、卡适配、跨集群成本削峰填谷等，提升推理资源利用率和响应速度；
4.· 协助Agent框架与FAT平台、LLM API、评测系统的打通，实现一站式Agent创建、上线与效果评估；
5.· 跟踪Agent与推理框架的前沿技术，结合业务需求探索创新方案并推动落地。

jobs.title: 金融科技-高级 AI 产品经理（反洗钱与尽调方向）
jobs.description:
1.：AI 化产品策划：负责反洗钱持续尽调产品的端到端规划，主导大模型能力在客户尽调场景的落地，覆盖 LLM 智能尽调问答、风险识别模型、Agent 工作流、可解释 AI 决策等方向；
2.：策略设计与效果监控：运用机器学习与数据分析方法，对全量客户的行为模式、交易链路进行深度挖掘，搭建可量化的全链路风险防控策略、核心指标监控体系与决策支持看板；
3.：端到端产品设计：从用户研究、需求拆解、原型设计到上线跟踪全流程负责，输出高质量 PRD、可落地方案与设计规范；
4.数据底层建设：理解并设计尽职调查相关的履职数据库表结构，负责数据准确性校验、履职数据提取与对账；
5.：前沿追踪与迭代：持续跟踪国内外反洗钱监管政策、AI 技术趋势与同业最佳实践，推动产品策略的持续迭代。

jobs.title: 高级投放 Agent 研发工程师（北京/深圳）
jobs.description:
1.参与或主导投放 Agent 技术架构与核心机制建设（运行时、编排、工具 / Skill、记忆等）；
2.攻坚核心业务难题：复杂任务可靠执行、多步操作的确定性与可控性、效果归因与决策质量；
3.将广告投放能力封装为 Agent 工具 / 技能，打通从用户意图到广告投放读写操作的全链路；
4.建设 Agent 评测与质量标准，保障对客交付的稳定性与可信度；
5.紧跟 LLM / Agent 前沿，沉淀方法论并形成技术影响力。

jobs.title: 高级游戏叙事策划（AI辅助工具方向）
jobs.description:
1.参与游戏智能NPC系统的叙事设计，基于大模型构建NPC行为逻辑，包括人格库、动态记忆与多轮对话策略；制定实时响应规则，在可预测性与涌现感之间取得平衡；产出Prompt模板及剧情种子数据；
2.探索AI辅助叙事的应用方式，借助大模型工具、自主编写Skill及开发提效工具，提升内容生产效率；
3.从叙事专业视角，协助优化AI辅助游戏制作工具。具备产品策划思维，能够通过埋点、自主设计优化及用户访谈等方式，持续迭代工具体验，降低用户的使用门槛。

jobs.title: 魔方在研轻动作风格化游戏预研项目技术美术专家（动画向）
jobs.description:
1.定义技术方向 — 主导动画状态机、动画树及动画管线的架构设计，制定技术规范与最佳实践，为团队提供清晰的技术路标；
2.攻克技术难题 — 深入解决动画系统中的复杂技术挑战，推动前沿技术（Motion Matching、程序化动画、物理动画）在 AAA 项目中的落地与量产；
3.建立质量标准 — 和动作负责人共同搭建动画品质审核机制与质量评估体系，系统性地保障并提升游戏内动画表现的上限；
4.赋能团队成长 — 作为技术动画领域的核心专家，指导并培养团队成员，推动跨部门（动画、策划、程序、引擎）的技术方案对齐与高效协作；
5.打通全链路 — 主导复杂动画系统的引擎集成，解决从 DCC 工具链到 Runtime 运行时的全链路技术难题，确保最高品质动画的落地；
6.引领技术前沿 — 持续关注行业前沿技术动态，评估新技术可行性，为团队提供具有前瞻性的技术路线建议。
